name: King of the Barfog Hills

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health, crowd-control immune, armour factor 350 with 20% absorb; resists 20% of melee and 30% of everything else.
20% of his hits add Crush: 400 natural damage to everyone within 800 of his target.
He walks home at full health when nobody is left on his aggro list; respawn is the epic-encounter interval.
His self-crowning the day the cattle left, the flattened grass, the ground that jumps round the struck man and his indifference to the lake are Living Server writing.

story:
Nobody crowned the King of the Barfog Hills. He crowned himself, the old men of Barfog say, the day the lady of the lake called her white cattle home and left the slopes above the water with nobody to keep them. He came through the open door after the cattle went in, or he was there before and only waited; the old men disagree. What they agree on is that he took the high ground north of the lake that same evening, and that he has kept it since, after his fashion.

He walks his hill as a king walks his hall. The grass lies flat where he has trodden, in paths that go round the whole of the high ground and back, and the hobgoblins and the bwgan go round his paths and not across them. He does not claim the lake. The afanc has the water and he has the hill, and in all the years the old men have watched them neither has troubled the other, which is more than can be said for anyone else in the hills.

He cannot be charmed, held, put to sleep or turned. A king does not take orders, the hill folk say, and his subjects never gave him any. He fights with his whole weight, and when he strikes a man the ground jumps under the man and under everyone standing near him, as if the hill itself were angry on its king's behalf; the old men of Barfog say a sensible subject keeps a long way from anyone the king is looking at. Teazanodwc keeps her hollow on the southern edge of his hills without asking his leave, and the old men say that is the only thing that has ever made him look up.

The ellyllon on the south-western slope call him the king with no crown, and bow when he passes, which is more than anyone else does. He has never once harmed an ellyll. They say it is because they bow. The old men of Barfog say it is because they are too small to notice.
legend: The King of the Barfog Hills, level 65, 30k, on the high ground north of the lake. A heavy melee fight with one trick: 20% of his hits add Crush, 400 natural damage to everyone within 800 of whoever he hit. So everyone who does not have to be near the tank stays more than 800 away from the tank, and the melee who do stay keep their health up. He is immune to mez, stun, root and the rest, so no crowd control plans. No adds. Tank, heal, burn. If everyone drops off him he goes home at full, and he respawns about an hour after he dies.

loremasterTopic.text: Nobody crowned him. He crowned himself the day the white cattle went home, and walks the high ground north of Llyn Barfog as a king walks his hall. No charm or command moves him, and the ground jumps round anyone he strikes. He leaves the afanc's water alone.

bookPage: From the Barfog Book of Twr ap Alsig. Of the king. My father took me up to see the king's paths when I was small. The grass on the high ground is flattened in rings, round and round, and the hobgoblins and the bwgan walk round the rings and never across. The king was walking. He did not look at us. My father said a sensible subject keeps a long way from anyone the king is looking at, because when he strikes, the hill strikes with him, and everyone near the man he hits goes down too. We were a long way off. I still felt it in my feet.
